summary: T1-03 meets its acceptance criteria on the evidence I gathered. All three listed checks pass, and the committed record is built from real PGDA78 Site01 files with the observed effective-support fraction and the ROI outlines. I did not re-run fetch, because it needs the network. I could not run `git check-ignore`, so I did not confirm that data/raw/ is ignored. The change touches only files in the story's list.

checks.evidence: 935 passed, 2 xfailed. The xfails are ProductRecord/Sources schema-case fixtures that belong to T1-01.

checks.criterion: uv run python -m terraluna_pipeline.pilot check pgda78
checks.command: uv run python -m terraluna_pipeline.pilot check pgda78
checks.evidence: Printed 'pgda78: committed outputs match data/raw/pgda78/'. The real raw data is present locally.
ruff check passed, ruff format --check passed, mypy reported no issues in 15 source files.

checks.criterion: CLI fetch/record/check semantics, determinism, offline tests, check leaves files unchanged, missing-raw message
checks.evidence: test_pilot.py defines test_record_is_deterministic_byte_for_byte (:683), test_check_passes_after_record_and_writes_nothing (:763), test_missing_raw_data_names_the_fetch_command (:798), test_an_incomplete_fetch_counts_as_missing (:807) and test_record_and_check_run_offline (:813). All of them passed. I did not read the test bodies.

checks.criterion: Source reads file list from README/index, fetches only needed files, whole-file under 200 MB, no 87S
checks.evidence: pilot.py:837-916 downloads three documents, then the five GeoTIFFs and the ROI archive. Each download is capped at WHOLE_FILE_LIMIT_BYTES. The xyzi file is listed in the record as not fetched. The 87S mosaic is never referenced.

checks.criterion: Record JSON contents from real files
checks.evidence: Per file: names, URLs, bytes (about 41 MB), sha256, CRS WKT from the file, 5 m pixel size, extent, nodata NaN, units, transform. dem_valid_fraction is 1.0. effective_support is observed 0.0949 and interpolated 0.9051, with a count histogram. The ROI archive lists 7 polygons and outlines_drawn is true. The retrieval date comes from fetch.json and tool_versions is present. Unknown fields use the string 'unknown'. The preview PNG is 80833 bytes.

checks.criterion: sources.json ProductRecords, sorted and upserted by product_id
checks.evidence: Six records sorted by product_id, covering the ROI tgz and five tifs. Each has a local_path under data/raw/pgda78/ and a real sha256. Unknown values are 'unknown' or null. Only the height file is marked VERIFIED; the rest are PARTIAL. The fetch-failure path has no live test; the code raises PilotError.

checks.criterion: Only small files committed; data/raw ignored
checks.evidence: The committed files are the 25 KB JSON, the 80 KB PNG and sources.json. The diff stat shows no GeoTIFF or tgz. The ignore check for data/raw was denied, so I did not confirm that data/raw is ignored.

findings.claim: make check runs only lint and mypy; pytest is not part of it.
findings.evidence: The make check output shows only ruff check, ruff format --check and mypy. This matches the story's checks list, so it is not a defect.

resolution.reason: The finding itself says this matches the story checks list and is not a defect. make check is defined in the Makefile (outside T1-03 files) as check-py: ruff check, ruff format --check and mypy. The test suite is the separate first check of the story, uv run pytest pipeline/tests, which passes after the round 1 fixes (981 passed, 2 strict xfails that belong to T1-01). No change is needed.

findings.claim: The record carries first and last retrieval times copied from the fetch metadata, and the real-file output depends on a local data/raw that I could not independently re-fetch.
findings.evidence: check passed against the local raw data. I did not run fetch, because it needs the network.

resolution.reason: Not a defect. AC1 requires record to copy the retrieval time from the fetch metadata and never read a clock, so re-running it reproduces outputs byte for byte. The gate runs only check, which is offline by design (story list description). check is still tied to the fetched bytes: _load_fetch in pilot.py refuses any raw file whose size or sha256 differs from data/raw/pgda78/fetch.json, which records each URL, HTTP status, byte count, sha256 and retrieval time of the real fetch (2026-11-14T19:39:28Z to 19:44:51Z). After the round 1 fixes, check pgda78 again prints that the committed outputs match data/raw/pgda78/.
